title: Enriched RAN Anomaly (ran-anomalies-enriched topic)
description: Schema for enriched anomaly records published to the ran-anomalies-enriched Kafka topic by the ran-rca-service after LLM-powered root cause analysis on ML-detected anomalies.

incident_id.description: Synthetic incident handle for chat and Kafka correlation.

zone.description: TelecomTS zone label (A, B, or C).

items.description: One timestep with 18 TelecomTS KPI channel values.

ad_label.description: Always 'anomalous' — only anomalous windows reach RCA.

ad_confidence.description: Softmax confidence from the Mantis AD binary classifier.

root_cause_category.description: Mantis RCA-derived category used to select the remediation playbook.

root_cause.description: LLM-determined root cause of the anomaly; empty when explanation is unavailable.

recommended_fix.description: LLM-recommended remediation action referencing vendor documentation; empty when explanation is unavailable.

ml_class.description: Original Mantis RCA label; empty when unavailable.

ml_confidence.description: Mantis RCA confidence, separate from anomaly-detection confidence.

timestamp.description: Time RCA enrichment completed, for incident ordering.
